name: Valley Health System Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help make each patient visit better. They work at Valley Health System hospitals in the Las Vegas area. They work with little supervision.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18 and enrolled in high school. You need a grade point average of 2.5 or higher, good English, and the ability to do tasks on your own.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. You must buy a volunteer shirt.
duration: Minimum 75 hours a year. The number varies by hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page or the application.
how_to_apply: Download the teen application from the program page. Fill it out with a parent consent form, a school records release, and a teacher or counselor evaluation. After review you get an interview. Call the volunteer office at the hospital you want.
notes: The application lists these hospitals: Centennial Hills, Valley, Henderson, Summerlin, Spring Valley and West Henderson. You also need a health screening. That includes a TB skin test each year. You must go to an orientation. Summerlin Hospital volunteer office phone: 702-233-7532.
